revision: rev2 — 2026-07-27. Companion to food-roles.json rev3. One label CORRECTED against rev1: 'Peanut butter, smooth style' moves side -> condiment, because the MP-7 holdout labeller was right and I was wrong. No other label was touched, and no label was changed to make a score look better. rev1 notes follow. Companion to food-roles.json rev1. The first 26 cases are transcribed verbatim from the MP-6b 21-meal sample; the rest are adversarial cases chosen to break rules that are too blunt.
author: Director
THIS_IS_A_TRAINING_SET: Read this before quoting a score from it. These cases were written alongside the rules they test, so a high score here measures self-consistency and nothing else. MP-3 scored 56/56 on the corpus its aliases were built from and 35/48 on a set written afterwards. A HOLDOUT IS MANDATORY: sample 60 rows uniformly at random from the real 14,484-row catalogue with a fixed, reported seed, hand-label them BEFORE running the resolver, and report that score separately. The holdout number is the real number.

scoring.wrongConfident: Assigning a specific role where the golden says another specific role. Target ZERO on the must-not cases.
scoring.unresolved: Falling through to `other`. Counted separately and far less serious than a wrong confident assignment.
scoring.gate: See TASK-MP7.md. Contested cases report but never block.
